title.zh: Tibo 的 28 天挑战

statement.zh: Tibo 承诺：接下来的 28 天，每天推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有用的明显改进，或进行一次完整额度重置。
statement.en: Tibo’s pledge: over 28 days, ship a clear improvement useful to most Codex / Work users each day, or a full quota reset.

title.zh: 默认速度提升约 50%

body.zh: Tibo 宣布优化 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度，覆盖订阅中的各产品及使用 ChatGPT 登录的合作伙伴产品。用户无需操作；原帖预计改进会在随后两小时内逐步生效。
body.en: Tibo announced faster defaults for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol across subscription products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT. No user action is needed; the post expected rollout over the following two hours.

title.zh: Auto-review 免费且不占套餐用量
title.en: Auto-review is free with ChatGPT sign-in

body.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 账户登录的所有用户，现可免费使用 Auto-review，且该功能不消耗套餐用量。在输入框下方的权限菜单选择“Approve for me”，即可使用 Auto-review，为长任务中的操作增加复核。
body.en: Users who sign in with a ChatGPT account can use Auto-review without a charge against their subscription usage. Open the permissions menu below the composer and select “Approve for me” to review actions taken during longer tasks.

title.zh: API 用量等级简化为三档
title.en: API usage tiers simplified to three

body.zh: OpenAI API 的付费用量等级由五档简化为 Build、Launch、Grow 三档。最高档 Grow 的累计 API 付款门槛从 1,000 美元降至 500 美元，更容易获得更高请求速率限制。
body.en: OpenAI API paid usage tiers are simplified from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. The total API payment threshold for Grow, the highest tier, is reduced from $1,000 to $500, making it easier to qualify for higher rate limits.

title.zh: Meetings 自动整理会议笔记
title.en: Meetings takes notes and prepares follow-ups

body.zh: Meetings 插件可记录会议，并在 ChatGPT Space 保存个性化摘要和后续步骤，支持私下保留或与团队分享。现向 macOS 版 ChatGPT 的 Pro 和 Business 用户开放测试，Enterprise 支持尚未推出。
body.en: The Meetings plugin takes notes and saves personalized summaries and next steps in ChatGPT Space. Notes can stay private or be shared with your team. It is available in beta for Pro and Business users in the ChatGPT macOS app; Enterprise support is coming later.

title.zh: Decisions API 开放公测

body.zh: Decisions API 现向所有开发者开放公测，可帮助应用近乎实时选择模型、工具或操作。官方称，其决策速度最高可达通过 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。Tibo 计划将其用于改善应用体验。
body.en: Decisions API is available to all developers in public beta for choosing models, tools, or actions in near real-time. OpenAI says it makes decisions up to 10 times faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API. Tibo plans to use it to improve the app experience.

title.zh: 第 2 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 宣布本次额度重置已处理完成，并确认此前发布的改进会保留。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has confirmed that the reset has been processed and that the earlier improvements will remain available. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: ChatGPT 推出新版 GPT-6
title.en: New GPT-6 rolling out in ChatGPT

body.zh: Tibo 宣布向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出新版 GPT-6，包含模型和基础设施改进；第 3 天总结明确将 GPT-6 in Chat 列为当天主要改进。新版正在推出，不代表所有账户已同时收到。
body.en: Tibo announced a new version of GPT-6 for all ChatGPT users, with model and infrastructure improvements. His Day 3 roundup identifies GPT-6 in Chat as the day’s main improvement. Rollout is underway; this does not mean every account has received it simultaneously.

title.zh: 第 3 天赠送重置已发放

body.zh: Tibo 已确认，第 3 天赠送的一次可留存重置已发放至所有付费账户。可查看当前账号的可用重置次数；这次发放不等于立即重置正在使用的额度。
body.en: Tibo has confirmed that the Day 3 banked reset has landed across all paid accounts. Check your account’s available resets; this grant does not immediately reset the quota currently in use.

title.zh: Codex Cloud 重新推出

body.zh: Tibo 在第 3 天追加记录中宣布重新推出 Codex Cloud。他引用的 Tailscale 公告介绍，Codex Cloud 可通过 Tailscale 安全连接其私有网络（tailnet）内的资源。
body.en: In a Day 3 encore, Tibo announced that Codex Cloud has been re-shipped. The Tailscale announcement he quoted describes securely connecting Codex Cloud to resources on a Tailscale private network (tailnet).

title.zh: 即时调整方向与 Sol Ultrafast

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 4 天改进：模型能更快响应任务进行中的调整，支持即时修正方向、减少无效工作；同时推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast。他引用的官方公告说明，Ultrafast 正在 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 逐步推出，不代表所有账户已同时可用。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 4 improvements: the model reacts faster to adjustments during a task, allowing real-time course correction and reducing wasted effort. He also announced GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast. The official post he quoted says Ultrafast is rolling out in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work; this does not mean every account has access simultaneously.

title.zh: 桌面端输入预测
title.en: Composer predictions in the desktop app

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 5 天改进：Codex 桌面端输入预测已向 Pro 用户开放测试，可根据当前对话及用户的表达方式建议下一条消息。该功能包含在 Pro 套餐中，不消耗套餐用量。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 5 composer predictions in the Codex desktop app, available in beta for Pro users. Codex can suggest the next message based on the conversation and how the user talks to it. The feature is included in Pro plans without consuming subscription usage.

title.zh: 手机端 dot 与工作委派

body.zh: Tibo 在第 5 天宣布，用户可通过 ChatGPT 的 iOS 和 Android 应用创建 dot 并与它发消息交流。随后他引用同组官方更新：dot 还可在 Codex 启动工作、跟进已有会话，结合 ChatGPT 对话、Codex 会话和自动任务，并更好地判断继续会话还是新建会话；也可查看和编辑 ChatGPT Work 的定时任务。
body.en: Tibo’s Day 5 update lets users create and text a dot in the ChatGPT app on iOS and Android. His follow-up quotes the same update thread: a dot can start work in Codex, follow up on existing threads using ChatGPT conversations, Codex threads and automations, and better decide whether to continue a thread or start fresh. It can also review and edit Scheduled Tasks in ChatGPT Work.

title.zh: ChatGPT 套餐额度接入 Devin
title.en: Use ChatGPT plan quota in Devin

body.zh: Tibo 引用 Cognition 公告宣布，个人 ChatGPT Go、Plus 或 Pro 套餐可连接 Devin。官方文档明确，需 Devin Pro、Max 或 Teams 套餐。连接并启用额度共享后，适用 GPT 模型用量从 ChatGPT 套餐额度扣除；fast/priority 模型变体不适用，其他模型仍使用 Devin 额度。
body.en: Tibo shared Cognition’s announcement that personal ChatGPT Go, Plus, or Pro plans can connect to Devin. The official documentation requires a Devin Pro, Max, or Teams plan. After linking and enabling plan sharing, eligible GPT model usage draws from the ChatGPT plan’s quota. Fast and priority variants are excluded, and usage from other models still draws from Devin quota.

title.zh: 第 6 天全球额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 6 天的全球额度重置计划，确认本次重置已全部生效。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 6 global quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset has fully propagated. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: Sol 默认上下文增至 500k

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 7 天改进：GPT-6.1 Sol 在 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的默认上下文由 272k 增至 500k，约提升 80%，可减少上下文压缩。仍可自行调高或调低，最大上下文为 1M；使用订阅额度时不收取长上下文费用。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 7: GPT-6.1 Sol’s default context in Codex and ChatGPT Work increases from 272k to 500k, about 80%, helping reduce compactions. Users can still override the default up or down, up to a 1M maximum. Long-context fees are not charged when usage draws from a subscription.

title.zh: 第 8 天全球额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 8 天的全球额度重置计划，确认本次重置已完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 8 global quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 桌面端状态存储占用优化

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 9 天改进：ChatGPT 和 Codex 桌面端已推出磁盘状态存储优化，预计可将所存状态的磁盘占用减少约 60%，缓解重度用户磁盘空间不足的问题。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 9: disk state storage optimizations have rolled out for the ChatGPT and Codex desktop apps, expected to reduce the amount of state stored on disk by about 60% and help power users running out of disk space.

title.zh: 第 10 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第 10 天的额度重置计划，确认本次重置已完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo quoted the Day 10 quota reset plan and confirmed that the reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 减少模型满载中断

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 11 天改进：已推出一系列调整并增加算力，以显著减少“所选模型已满载，请尝试其他模型”的中断。仍遇到时，任务应能随后自动继续，避免一直阻塞。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 11: changes and additional compute have landed to significantly reduce “Selected model is at capacity” interruptions. When they still occur, the task should eventually continue automatically instead of remaining blocked.

title.zh: 提升 Codex 与 Work 用量效率
title.en: More effective usage in Codex and Work

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 12 天改进：通过在子代理之间复用上下文、延长上下文缓存时间及优化请求路由以提高缓存命中率，增加 Codex 和 Work 的有效可用量。
body.en: Tibo announced Day 12 improvements that increase effective usage in Codex and Work by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and routing requests to improve cache hits.

title.zh: GPT-6 Astra Pro 响应与工具升级
title.en: GPT-6 Astra Pro response and tool upgrades

body.zh: Tibo 在第 12 天原帖下补充 GPT-6 Pro 改进，并引用 OpenAI 公告：ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Astra Pro 响应更快，插件和工具使用得到改善，支持多个代理并行处理任务。目前面向 Pro 用户在 Chat 页签开放，可查看各代理进度及完成结果。
body.en: In his Day 12 thread, Tibo highlighted GPT-6 Pro improvements and quoted OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT has faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and multiple agents working in parallel. It is available to Pro users in the Chat tab, with agent progress and completed tasks available for review.

title.zh: 在主屏幕使用 dot

body.zh: Tibo 在第 12 天原帖下引用 Gavin Nelson 的“Dots, now on your Home Screen”更新，提示更新应用后使用主屏幕上的 dot。
body.en: In his Day 12 thread, Tibo shared Gavin Nelson’s “Dots, now on your Home Screen” update and asked users to update their app to use it.

title.zh: ChatGPT Space 新增幻灯片支持

body.zh: Tibo 在 ChatGPT Space 介绍帖下确认已新增幻灯片支持，目前面向 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户开放，并在收集反馈。
body.en: In his ChatGPT Space introduction thread, Tibo confirmed that slides support has been added and is currently available to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users while the team gathers feedback.

title.zh: 第 13 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: 第 13 天额度重置已完成。Tibo 随后发布“Done”；原 EOD 计划已过期，不再显示待确认。完成公告时间不代表各账号实际到账时刻。
body.en: The Day 13 quota reset is complete. Tibo subsequently posted “Done”; the original EOD deadline has passed, so the event is no longer pending confirmation. The announcement time is not each account’s actual reset time.

title.zh: 桌面应用支持编辑历史消息
title.en: Edit previous messages in the desktop app

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第 14 天改进：现在可以在桌面应用中编辑同一聊天内的历史消息。
body.en: Tibo announced the Day 14 improvement: previous messages within a thread can now be edited in the desktop app.

title.zh: 第 15 天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用先前的第 15 天节目帖，宣布已进行额度重置：“and reset. Enjoy.”。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Quoting his earlier Day 15 broadcast post, Tibo announced a quota reset: “and reset. Enjoy.” Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 用量扣算与套餐不一致问题已修复

body.zh: Tibo 确认约 4 万个账号的用量扣算与实际所选套餐不一致，问题已修复，团队正在逐一联系受影响用户，并承诺向受影响账号补发 credits；原帖未说明金额或到账时间。
body.en: Tibo identified about 40,000 accounts whose applied usage limits did not match their selected plan. The issue is corrected, affected users are being contacted individually, and credits will be added to affected accounts. No amount or delivery time was specified.

title.zh: 延长缓存并支持恢复旧会话
title.en: Longer caching and cached conversation resumes

body.zh: Tibo 宣布 API 可选 12 小时缓存；Codex 与 Work 登录用户的缓存将持续保留，返回旧会话或间隔数小时后继续时可保证命中缓存，不再因此受罚。
body.en: Tibo announced optional 12-hour API caching. For logged-in Codex and Work users, cache is kept indefinitely, with guaranteed cache hits and no penalty when returning to an old conversation or resuming hours later.

title.zh: 第17天额度重置计划

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第17天将进行额度重置，并在相关回复中说明“明天 PST 上午10点前到账”。目前按计划记录，尚无完成确认；原帖未明确适用范围。
body.en: Tibo announced a Day 17 quota reset and added in a related reply: “Lands tomorrow before 10am PST.” Recorded as planned, with no completion confirmation or explicit eligibility scope.

title.zh: Decisions API 正式可用

body.zh: Tibo 在第18天更新中宣布 Decisions API 已正式可用，并提到已发布一些性能改进；原帖未提供性能细节。
body.en: In his Day 18 update, Tibo announced that the Decisions API is generally available and mentioned shipped performance improvements, without detailing those improvements.

title.zh: 第18天额度重置计划

body.zh: Tibo 宣布第18天再次进行额度重置，并在相关回复中说明将于“明天 PST 上午10点前”与一项小更新一起落地。目前按计划记录，尚无完成确认或明确适用范围。
body.en: Tibo announced another quota reset for Day 18. A related reply says it will land tomorrow before 10am PST alongside a small update. Recorded as planned; completion and eligibility scope were not specified.

title.zh: 通话、缓存与 CLI 改进

body.zh: dots 通话连接更快；Codex／Work 会话中切换 reasoning 不再使缓存失效。CLI 新增可复用提示预设、会话内模型及权限设置、企业 MCP 登录和 Windows 企业代理认证，并修复长会话恢复失败。
body.en: Dots calls connect faster, and changing reasoning mid-conversation in Codex and Work no longer invalidates cache. CLI updates add reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, enterprise MCP sign-in and Windows corporate-proxy authentication, and fix long-session resume failures.

title.zh: 第20天额度重置已完成

body.zh: Tibo 引用第20天重置截止回复，宣布已全部传播完成。公告不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻，原文未明确适用范围。
body.en: Quoting the Day 20 reset deadline reply, Tibo announced that it has all propagated. This announcement does not establish each account’s actual arrival time; eligibility scope was not specified.

title.zh: 第21天重置已按计划到期完成
title.en: Day 21 reset marked complete after EOD

body.zh: 已按 EOD 计划到期自动标记完成。依据 Tibo“今天重置”的计划，美西10月25日的估算截止已过；这不是官方完成确认，也不代表每个账号的实际到账时刻。
body.en: Automatically marked complete after the estimated EOD deadline. The estimated end of October 25 in Los Angeles has passed for Tibo’s “today” reset plan. This is not official completion confirmation or each account’s actual arrival time.
